description.detail: Restricting ligands to compounds measured against two or more kinases cuts the balanced graph from 71,949 nodes / 160,462 edges to 22,531 / 114,098 (-69% nodes, -46,364 edges), with single-target compounds moved to the verdict layer rather than discarded. On the fixed held-out set RGCN macro rose 0.338123 to 0.347516 and micro 0.274393 to 0.275689.
